chartTypeId.help: The control chart type: I-MR for individual values (individuals chart and moving range chart), X̄-R for subgroups (mean and range chart) or X̄-S for subgroups (mean and standard deviation chart). The selection in the interface keeps the subgroup size within the range of the new type; I-MR always computes with n = 1. If only the type is written and the stored subgroup size does not fit it, the change is rejected. Frozen limits only apply with the type they were frozen with.

subgroupSize.help: Subgroup size (n): the number of consecutive values that form one subgroup, a whole number from 2 to 10 for X̄-R and from 2 to 25 for X̄-S. For I-MR it is 1 and the field is hidden. Leftover values at the end that do not fill a subgroup are ignored. A number outside the range of the chart type is rejected; the reason appears below the field. Frozen limits only apply with the subgroup size they were frozen with.

columnRef.help: The column with the measured values in time order, labelled Measurement Column. Only numbers are used; empty cells and text, including text such as “2,5”, are skipped. The analysis needs at least 2 numbers; an X̄ chart needs at least one full subgroup, otherwise it reports “Computation failed.”. Empty while none is chosen; without a column or with a deleted column the output stays empty. Choosing a different column in the interface discards frozen limits. A change of the column or its values recomputes.

baselineCount.help: Baseline count (Phase I): how many individual values from the start of the series the center line and limits are computed from, a whole number of at least 1; empty means all values. The rules then check all points. For X̄ charts it is rounded up to whole subgroups. If the number exceeds the number of values, all values count (for X̄ charts all full subgroups). Excluded points within it do not enter the limits; the baseline does not get longer because of them. When frozen limits apply, the value takes effect only after thawing. With stages it is not used; each stage then computes from all of its values.

stagesText.help: Stage boundaries: the number of the last individual value of each stage, separated by comma, semicolon or space, e.g. 12, 25. Only whole numbers greater than 0 and less than the number of values count; if none is left, the chart computes without stages. Each stage gets its own center line and limits and is judged by them; the KPIs and capability describe the last stage. If a boundary falls inside a subgroup, that subgroup is counted in the earlier stage and a hint appears. Empty means a single baseline. With stages neither exclusions nor frozen limits take effect, and no limits can be frozen for Phase II.

usl.help: USL: upper specification limit of the individual values, empty for none; a number with a decimal point. It is shown as a line on the first subchart and enters Cp, Cpu and Cpk. It comes from the customer or the drawing, not from the data, and is not a control limit.

lsl.help: LSL: lower specification limit of the individual values, empty for none; a number with a decimal point. It is shown as a line on the first subchart and enters Cp, Cpl and Cpk. It comes from the customer or the drawing, not from the data, and is not a control limit.

enabledRules.help: The checked Nelson Rules, numbers 1 to 8: 1 one point beyond 3σ; 2 nine points on the same side of the center line; 3 six points increasing or decreasing; 4 fourteen points alternating up and down; 5 two of three points beyond 2σ on the same side; 6 four of five points beyond 1σ on the same side; 7 fifteen points within 1σ; 8 eight points beyond 1σ on both sides. σ is the spread σ̂ of the respective subchart. Only rule 1 is preset, because every further rule raises the false alarm rate. The individuals or X̄ chart is checked; on the MR, R or S chart only rules 1 to 4 apply and their violations only show in that chart's badge. With stages every rule restarts at each stage boundary.

annotations.help: The annotations per point of the first subchart, counted from 0, each entry described individually under keys. They are written only through the annotation commands, which check the point against the result. An excluded point is left out of the limit computation; with multiple stages and with frozen limits the exclusion has no effect. For X̄ charts the subgroup that contains the individual value with this number drops out, not the subgroup with this number.

frozenLimits.help: The limits of both subcharts frozen for Phase II, empty in live mode (Phase I); each entry described individually under keys. They are written only through the Phase II command. They apply only with the same chart type, the same subgroup size and the same column and without stages; whether they currently apply is given by frozen in the result.

charts.help: The chart editor settings per subchart, under i (individuals chart), mr (MR chart), xbar (X̄ chart, shared by X̄-R and X̄-S), r (R chart) and s (S chart): title, axis titles, font sizes, background, reference lines, point colour, symbol, size and outline of the series. A subchart without changes has no entry; other keys are rejected.

exampleWorksheetId.help: The id of the example worksheet this module was loaded from; empty if it does not come from an example.

analysis.help: The computation for the current column and settings: the numbers used, per subchart the points, center line, limits and σ̂ (per point with stages), the rule violations, the effective stages, the end of the baseline, whether frozen limits apply and the capability, or the reason errCompute when the computation fails or yields non-finite values. Empty without a column, with a deleted column and with fewer than 2 numbers.

result.help: The computed result, each figure described individually under keys; empty without a column, with a deleted column, with fewer than 2 numbers or when the computation fails (the interface then shows “Computation failed.”), for example with fewer values than one subgroup or with values whose limits are no longer finite.

points.help: One row per plotted point of the first subchart (per subgroup for X̄ charts) with the value, center line, upper and lower limit of each subchart (i, iCl, iUcl, iLcl, mr, mrCl, mrUcl, mrLcl, or xbar, r or s with the same suffixes) and signal, whether the point violates a rule. The MR chart has no value in the first row and at the start of each stage. Empty without a result. read({ fields: ['points'] }) returns them in full.

activeColumnSlots.help: The column fields currently in effect: always just the measurement column columnRef.

activeParams.help: The settings that apply to the current chart type: chartTypeId, baselineCount, stagesText, usl, lsl and enabledRules, plus subgroupSize only for X̄-R and X̄-S.

setChartType.help: Switches the control chart type and keeps the subgroup size within the range of the new type: I-MR sets n = 1, X̄-R limits it to 2 to 10, X̄-S to 2 to 25. The selection in the interface works the same way. Frozen limits of a different type stay stored but only apply again with the old type.

params.chartTypeId: The new type: i-mr, xbar-r or xbar-s. Any other value is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with chartTypeId.

toggleRule.help: Checks or unchecks a Nelson rule; the list of checked rules stays free of duplicates and ascending.

params.ruleId: The rule, 1 to 8 (meaning given for the checked rules). Any other value is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with ruleId and on.

removeAnnotation.help: Removes the annotation of a point together with its exclusion; an excluded point then enters the limits again. In the interface it is the delete button in the annotation dialog, with a confirmation.

params.index: The point, counted from 0, that carries an annotation; a point without an annotation is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with index.

setAnnotation.help: Annotates a point with a comment or excludes it from the limit computation; the analysis is then recomputed. Without a comment and without exclusion the annotation is removed. In the interface a click on a row of the rule violations opens this dialog.

params.index: The point of the first subchart, counted from 0 (the subgroup for X̄ charts); it must exist in the current result.
params.comment: Comment / cause for the point, e.g. a tool break on shift 3; empty for none. The point is marked on the chart and the comment appears in the list of rule violations.
params.excluded: Exclude point from limit computation: the point stays on the chart as a gray cross but no longer influences the center line, UCL and LCL; for I-MR the two moving ranges that involve it also drop out of MR̄. The analysis is then recomputed. Does not apply with multiple stages or when frozen limits are in effect. For X̄ charts the subgroup that contains the individual value with this number drops out, not the clicked subgroup.
params.command: The command as one object with index, comment and excluded.

setPhase2.help: Freezes the current limits of both subcharts for Phase II monitoring or thaws them again. While frozen, all points, including new ones, are judged against the fixed limits instead of recomputing them. Without a result and with stages freezing is rejected, with the interface's hint. Whether frozen limits apply afterwards is given by frozen in the result.

params.enabled: true freezes, false thaws and computes live again.
params.command: The command as one object with enabled.

lastN.help: How many of the most recent points the tile's chart shows, 0 to 500; 0 shows all. The figures always count all points.

showChart.help: Shows or hides the tile's chart; the figures remain.

Result.chartType: The control chart type used: i-mr (I-MR), xbar-r (X̄-R) or xbar-s (X̄-S). It determines the subcharts: i and mr, xbar and r, or xbar and s.
Result.subgroupSize: The subgroup size (n) used; 1 for I-MR.
Result.n: Number of points of the first subchart: for I-MR the usable numbers of the column (empty and non-numeric cells are dropped), for X̄ charts the number of full subgroups.
Result.baselineEnd: How many individual values, not subgroups, the baseline covers: the baseline count, at most all values (for X̄ charts the values of all full subgroups); all values when it is empty or stages apply.
Result.stages: The stage boundaries used, as numbers of the last individual value of each stage, ascending and without duplicates; boundaries outside the series are dropped. Empty without stages.
Result.frozen: True when frozen Phase II limits apply: chart type, subgroup size and column must match the time of freezing, and no stages may be set. The points are then judged against these limits instead of recomputed ones. The Phase II badge, by contrast, only follows whether limits are stored and can show “frozen” although they do not apply.
Result.subcharts: The limits per subchart of the chart type: i and mr for I-MR, xbar and r for X̄-R, xbar and s for X̄-S. With stages they hold the limits of the last stage, i.e. the process as it runs now.
Result.capability: Process capability against USL and LSL, computed from the center line CL and σ̂ of the first subchart, converted to individual values for X̄ charts; with stages from the last stage, with frozen limits from the frozen values. Empty when no specification limit is set or σ̂ = 0. Which figures exist depends on which limits are set.
Result.violations: The rule violations of the first subchart (individuals or X̄ chart) under the checked Nelson Rules, once per point and rule, sorted by point. The check of the second subchart only shows in the chart's badge.
Result.signals: The points of the first subchart with at least one rule violation, each only once, counted from 0 over the plotted points (subgroups for X̄ charts). The violations tile counts these points, its sub-line gives the number of points. The dashboard tile computes without stages, exclusions and frozen limits and can therefore show a different number.

SubchartLimits.cl: CL (Center Line) of the subchart: the mean of the baseline points without excluded points, i.e. x̄ on the individuals chart, x̄̄ on the X̄ chart and MR̄, R̄ or S̄ on the dispersion chart. When frozen limits apply (Phase II), CL, UCL, LCL and σ̂ are the values computed at freezing, not those of the current baseline. The CL tile shows the center line of the first subchart, its sub-line σ̂; with several stages the values of the last stage. The dashboard tile computes without stages, exclusions and frozen limits and can therefore show different values.
SubchartLimits.ucl: UCL, upper control limit of the subchart. I-MR: x̄ + 3 · MR̄/d₂ = x̄ + 2.660 · MR̄ with d₂ = 1.128, MR chart D₄ · MR̄ = 3.267 · MR̄. X̄-R: x̄̄ + A₂ · R̄, R chart D₄ · R̄. X̄-S: x̄̄ + A₃ · S̄, S chart B₄ · S̄. The constants depend on n (table in the handbook). With frozen limits the value computed at freezing applies. The UCL / LCL tile shows the UCL of the first subchart with the LCL below.
SubchartLimits.lcl: LCL, lower control limit of the subchart. I-MR: x̄ − 3 · MR̄/d₂ = x̄ − 2.660 · MR̄, MR chart 0. X̄-R: x̄̄ − A₂ · R̄, R chart D₃ · R̄. X̄-S: x̄̄ − A₃ · S̄, S chart B₃ · S̄. The constants depend on n; D₃ is 0 up to n = 6, B₃ up to n = 5. With frozen limits the value computed at freezing applies.
SubchartLimits.sigma: σ̂, the estimated spread of the points of this subchart, one third of the distance from the center line to the UCL. Individuals chart MR̄/d₂ = MR̄/1.128; X̄ chart R̄/(d₂ · √n) or S̄/(c₄ · √n); dispersion chart (UCL − CL)/3. The zones of the Nelson Rules (1σ, 2σ, 3σ) refer to it. With frozen limits the value computed at freezing applies.

Capability.cp: Cp = (USL − LSL)/(6σ): how often the spread fits into the tolerance, regardless of location. Only with both specification limits; the Cpk tile shows Cp in its sub-line.
Capability.cpu: Cpu = (USL − x̄)/(3σ): distance of the mean to the upper specification limit in units of three σ. Only with a USL.
Capability.cpl: Cpl = (x̄ − LSL)/(3σ): distance of the mean to the lower specification limit in units of three σ. Only with an LSL.
Capability.cpk: Cpk, the smaller of Cpu and Cpl, with only one limit its value. σ is the within spread: MR̄/d₂ for I-MR, R̄/d₂ for X̄-R, S̄/c₄ for X̄-S (σ̂ of the means times √n); x̄ is the center line of the first subchart, with stages of the last stage; with frozen limits x̄ and σ come from the frozen values. The tile is green (capable) from 1.33, yellow (conditionally capable) from 1.0, red below. The dashboard tile computes Cpk over all values, without stages, exclusions and frozen limits.

Violation.index: The violating point of the first subchart, counted from 0 over the plotted points: for I-MR the usable numbers without empty cells, for X̄ charts the subgroups.
Violation.ruleId: The number of the violated Nelson rule, 1 to 8, in the same numbering as the Nelson Rules selection.

Annotation.comment: Comment / cause for the point, e.g. a tool break on shift 3; empty for none. The point is marked on the chart.
Annotation.excluded: Exclude point from limit computation: the point stays visible on the chart but no longer influences UCL and LCL. The analysis is then recomputed. Does not apply with multiple stages or when frozen limits are in effect. For X̄ charts the subgroup that contains the individual value with this number drops out.

FrozenLimits.chartTypeId: The control chart type at the time of freezing. The frozen limits only apply while the same type is selected.
FrozenLimits.subgroupSize: The subgroup size (n) at the time of freezing. The frozen limits only apply with the same subgroup size.
FrozenLimits.columnRef: The measurement column at the time of freezing. If a different column is chosen in the interface, the frozen limits are discarded; they never apply to a different column.
FrozenLimits.baselineEnd: How many individual values the baseline covered at the time of freezing.
FrozenLimits.primary: The frozen limits of the first subchart (individuals or X̄ chart): center line, UCL, LCL and σ̂, unchanged from the computation at the time of freezing.
FrozenLimits.secondary: The frozen limits of the second subchart (MR, R or S chart): center line, UCL, LCL and σ̂, unchanged from the computation at the time of freezing.
FrozenLimits.excludedIndices: The points that were excluded from the limit computation at the time of freezing, counted from 0.

TileAnalysis.outOfSpec: Number of points on the individuals or means chart that lie above the upper or below the lower specification limit, counted over all points. Shown only when at least one specification limit is set. For X̄ charts means are counted, not individual values.
